integrity: The shifted Jacobian and cubic focal coefficient were reconstructed from the published vector field. The published two-scroll parameter example was replayed with exact symbolic arithmetic; numerical trajectories are not used as proof.
scientific_limitations: Local center-manifold classification only. The exceptional surfaces \(a=0\) and \(b^2=d^2\) are not resolved, and no claim is made about global basins or the existence of the numerically reported remote chaotic attractors.
title: A generic weak-focus criterion at the nominal center of a three-dimensional scroll flow
